title: The preserved probe may NOT be carried into a replacement screening session, and no protocol decision is needed to proceed
status: RESOLVED 2026-10-11 against the frozen design, before any score exists
_contract: The compatibility analysis the 2026-10-11 maintainer decision required before reusing a preserved training artifact. It changes no frozen value, requests no exception, and authorizes nothing. It records why the frozen design answers the question by itself.
the_question: Attempts 3 and 4 both produced valid training for the frozen unit d1_screening_q1_s614923639 and zero valid scores. Their checkpoints differ in bytes (aadfb955... and 71387681...). The maintainer's condition was to PREFER the most recent valid preserved artifact (71387681...) as an evaluation-only continuation under P8.4, AFTER establishing that such a continuation is compatible with the frozen paired-screening protocol.
the_answer: IT IS NOT COMPATIBLE. The frozen design forbids it directly, in a clause written for exactly this hazard.

the_governing_clause.how: all probes of a rung are trained and evaluated in ONE session on one host, under one image digest, one engine version and one scoring contract
the_governing_clause.requirement: every probe in one comparison field is GENERATED and EVALUATED under one protocol identity
the_governing_clause._not_a_between_session_comparison: A3's remaining unquantified alternative explanation is that its treatment and controls were measured in different sessions. D1 does not inherit that: both arms of each rung are measured together.
the_governing_clause._reading: The clause says TRAINED and evaluated, not merely evaluated. Carrying one probe's training across a session boundary is the one thing it names as the defect D1 was designed not to inherit.

why_it_is_a_real_confound_and_not_a_form: The screening field RANKS five arms against each other at each of two seeds. Importing q1's s614923639 training from a different session, on a different physical host, would give exactly ONE of the five ranked arms a cross-session training draw while q2, q3, q4 and B got same-session draws.

That asymmetry falls precisely on the comparison the ranking makes. Within-session training nondeterminism is shared by every arm and is the noise the paired design already absorbs; a nuisance applied to one arm only is a confound, not noise.

The size is UNKNOWN and would stay unknown. Training is not bit-reproducible on CUDA (see d1_probe_training_is_not_bit_reproducible.json), so the cross-session component cannot be separated from the arm effect after the fact. An unquantifiable alternative explanation attached to one arm is what A3 was left with.

The maintainer's own condition names the hazard: 'An operational session boundary must not silently become a treatment difference.' Here it would not be silent -- it would be documented -- but it would still be a treatment difference.

why_NO_maintainer_protocol_decision_is_r.the_third_option: Train all ten probes in one session, which is what the frozen design SAYS. That requires no exception, no policy change and no protocol decision -- it is the protocol.
why_NO_maintainer_protocol_decision_is_r.it_is_now_affordable: The continuation was only ever an optimization for an envelope that no longer binds. After the 2026-10-11 amendment the reconciled remainder is $21.6695 against a MEASURED all-in need of ~$18.10 for a complete fresh ten-probe run, with the attempt's narrowed hard bound at 1129 minutes against a measured 981.7. The clean path fits with roughly 15% headroom.
why_NO_maintainer_protocol_decision_is_r.so_the_stop_condition_is_not_reached: The maintainer asked for a stop only if the prohibition 'actually forbids this continuation' AND a protocol decision were therefore needed. It does forbid it, but the remedy is to execute the frozen protocol rather than to amend it, so there is nothing to decide.
why_NO_maintainer_protocol_decision_is_r._and_no_policy_is_rewritten: This is settled BEFORE any score exists, from the design text alone. Nothing here depends on an outcome, and the cross-session prohibition is left exactly as committed.

this_is_not_retraining_for_convenience._the_maintainers_constraint: 'Do not retrain a valid, restorable scientific unit merely for convenience.'
this_is_not_retraining_for_convenience.the_reason_is_scientific: the retrain buys protocol uniformity across the five ranked arms, which the frozen design requires in terms. It is not chosen to avoid work -- the opposite: it costs 60.9 GPU-minutes ($1.12 all-in) that the continuation would have saved, out of a $3.57 margin.
this_is_not_retraining_for_convenience.the_continuation_would_also_have_cost_re: the maintainer required proof of COMPLETED LFS upload and download rather than an available batch action. That is a 2.22 GiB upload at the measured 0.72 MB/s dev-box uplink -- about 53 minutes of wall clock -- plus a verified download, to save $1.12 and acquire a confound.

what_happens_to_the_two_preserved_checkp.disposition: ARCHIVAL EVIDENCE. Neither is an input to any measurement.
what_happens_to_the_two_preserved_checkp.attempt_132919: 71387681f3a9d2162ad9aebd88b6c44eb32cd99f65437d4a95250790f86ab6c6, verified byte-identical at 2026-10-11 by recomputing the shard's sha256
what_happens_to_the_two_preserved_checkp.not_pooled_and_not_chosen_by_outcome: neither was selected using behavioural scores, because neither has any: both sessions produced zero valid scores. The choice recorded here is made on the design text, before any score exists.
what_happens_to_the_two_preserved_checkp.they_remain_proof: that the trained-but-unscored durability mechanism works on a real failure, which is why they were preserved and why that is still worth having.

when_the_resume_mechanism_IS_the_right_t: Whole-field carry-over, not partial. A session that trains all ten probes and then fails at scoring or aggregation can resume and score those ten: they share one training session and one host, so protocol_uniformity holds. The mechanism is not being retired -- its compatible use is the whole field, and the incompatible use is importing a subset into a differently-trained field. The driver's identity-checked resume and its regressions stand unchanged.
